bash -lc 'set -e; python3 - << "PY"
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("src/range.c")
text = p.read_text()
old_line = "ary = mrb_ary_new_capa(mrb, (mrb_int)(b - a) + 1);"
pos = text.find(old_line)
print("pos", pos)
if pos == -1:
  raise SystemExit("anchor not found")
insert = (
  "\n      mrb_int cap = (mrb_int)(b - a) + 1;\n"
  "      if (cap < 0) cap = 0;\n"
  "      ary = mrb_ary_new_capa(mrb, cap);\n"
  "      mrb_value *ptr = RARRAY_PTR(ary);\n"
  "      mrb_int i = 0;"
)
text = text[:pos+len(old_line)] + insert + text[pos+len(old_line):]
p.write_text(text)
print("patched1 done")
text = p.read_text()
text = text.replace("while (a < b) {", "while (a < b && i < cap) {")
text = text.replace("while (a <= b) {", "while (a <= b && i < cap) {")
p.write_text(text)
print("patched2 done")
PY'
bash -lc 'set -e; cd /src/mruby; git status --porcelain; rg -n --no-ignore-vcs -S "range_num_to_a|range.c" -S src/mruby || true'
bash -lc 'set -e; cd /src/mruby; secb build'

bash -lc 'set -e; cd /src/mruby; python3 - << "PY"
p = "src/range.c"
text = open(p).read().splitlines()
out = []
in_float_block = False
for line in text:
    stripped = line.strip()
    if stripped == "#ifndef MRB_NO_FLOAT":
        in_float_block = True
        out.append(line)
        continue
    if in_float_block and stripped == "#endif":
        in_float_block = False
        out.append(line)
        continue
    if in_float_block and (stripped == "mrb_value *ptr = RARRAY_PTR(ary);" or stripped == "mrb_int i = 0;"):
        # skip the redundant declarations
        continue
    out.append(line)
open(p, 'w').write('\n'.join(out) + '\n')
print('patched ranges')
PY'
